newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CBA lowers mortgage rate on deeming move.
newsitem.headline: CBA lowers mortgage rate on deeming move.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said it would reduce the mortgage rate on its no-frills variable mortgage rate by 20 basis points to 6.15 percent after the government's decision to cut the deeming rate for pensioners.

CBA, which has the largest mortgage book of the big four Australian banks, said the new "Economiser" home loan rate would apply to new borrowers from August 18 and to current borrowers from September 22.
The government said earlier on Friday that it would lower the deeming rate which banks must pay pensioners on their deposits by one percentage point.
CBA cut the Economiser rate by 35 basis points from 6.70 percent on July 30, the same day that the Reserve Bank eased the official cash rate by 50 basis points.
